title: Wire EDM Advanced AI — Quality, Diagnostics, Learning, Cost

units.title: Quality/inspection AI domains
units.details: Added 4 quality domains: wedm_dimensional_verification (measurement planning), wedm_spc_analysis (process control), wedm_metrology_strategy (equipment/procedures), wedm_first_article (AS9102/PPAP FAI)

units.title: Troubleshooting/diagnostics AI domains
units.details: Added 4 diagnostics domains: wedm_wire_break_diagnosis (root cause analysis), wedm_dimension_drift (thermal/wear compensation), wedm_surface_defect (witness lines, recast issues), wedm_process_recovery (restart procedures)

units.title: Learning/optimization AI domains
units.details: Added 4 learning domains: wedm_performance_prediction (outcome forecasting), wedm_historical_analysis (trend identification), wedm_continuous_improvement (OEE/cycle time), wedm_calibration_learning (offset/timing updates)

units.title: Cost/scheduling AI domains
units.details: Added 4 planning domains: wedm_cost_estimation (detailed costing), wedm_cycle_prediction (time forecasting), wedm_machine_routing (job allocation), wedm_capacity_planning (forecast vs capacity)

units.title: Tribal synthesis for advanced domains
units.details: Added all 16 advanced domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection

units.title: WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine advanced AI integration
units.details: Extended collectAIRecommendations() with 10 new domain calls (quality, diagnostics, performance, cost). Conditional FAI for aerospace/medical. Extended ai_recommendations interface with 16 new fields. Enhanced synthesis report with verification, FAI, wire break, performance, cost, cycle time summaries.

units.title: Advanced AI test suite
units.details: 26 tests covering: quality/inspection domains (4), troubleshooting domains (4), learning domains (4), cost/scheduling domains (4), orchestration integration (6), synthesis report (1), tribal synthesis (3)

quality_inspection: wedm_spc_analysis — control charts, Cp/Cpk, sampling strategy
troubleshooting_diagnostics: wedm_dimension_drift — thermal, wear, stress release diagnosis
wedm_surface_defect — witness lines, recast, pitting correction
learning_optimization: wedm_performance_prediction — cycle time, Ra, accuracy forecasting
wedm_historical_analysis — trend identification, best practice mining
wedm_continuous_improvement — OEE, cycle time, quality kaizen
wedm_calibration_learning — offset, timing, material database updates
cost_scheduling: wedm_cost_estimation — machine time, wire, consumables, overhead
wedm_cycle_prediction — cut time, threading, rapids, contingency
wedm_capacity_planning — forecast vs capacity, shift optimization

integration_points.WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine: Conditional AI for aerospace FAI, diagnostics, cost/cycle prediction

summary: Advanced AI hardening for Wire EDM operations management. 16 new domains covering: quality/inspection (verification, SPC, metrology, FAI), troubleshooting (wire breaks, dimension drift, surface defects, recovery), learning (performance prediction, historical analysis, continuous improvement, calibration), and cost/scheduling (estimation, cycle prediction, routing, capacity). All domains integrated into pipeline with conditional activation. 26 tests + prior 69 = 95 total WEDM AI tests.
